topics.topic: PT PP (Persero) Tbk interest payment delay on Sustainable Bond III Phase I 2021 Series B and Sustainable Sukuk Mudharabah I Phase I 2021 Series B, causing BEI trading suspension
topics.known_state: PT PP delayed the interest and profit‑sharing payments on its Sustainable Bond III Phase I 2021 Series B and Sustainable Sukuk Mudharabah I Phase I 2021 Series B, originally due 2 Oct 2026, with a combined liability of roughly Rp 17.1 billion. The delay was reported by KSEI and, on 5 Oct 2026, BEI temporarily halted trading of PT PP across all market segments from the pre‑open session, citing a going‑concern issue.

topics.topic: PT Bank Of India Indonesia trading suspension due to abnormal price surge and consecutive Auto Reject Top triggers
topics.known_state: BEI halted trading of PT Bank Of India Indonesia Tbk (BSWD) on 5 Oct 2026 at the start of the session, citing a cumulative price surge of 140% over the past month and 323.5% year‑to‑date, and four consecutive Auto Reject Top triggers since 28 Sep 2026, when the stock rose from Rp1,485 to Rp3,600. The lock applied to both the Regular and Cash Markets from the pre‑opening session.

topics.topic: PT Graha Layar Prima flagged for Unusual Market Activity after share price surge and Auto Reject Top triggers
topics.known_state: BEI flagged PT Graha Layar Prima Tbk (BLTZ) for Unusual Market Activity on 5 Oct 2026 after the stock rose 142.59% from its September 30 opening price of Rp1,855, reaching the Auto Reject Top level for four consecutive sessions. BEI noted that UMA does not automatically indicate a regulatory breach and urged the company to improve disclosure and transparency regarding its performance.

topics.topic: PT Graha Layar Prima H1 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: PT Graha Layar Prima Tbk (BLTZ) reported net revenue of IDR 512.4 billion and a net loss of IDR 14.72 billion for the first half of 2026, compared with a net profit of IDR 25.21 billion in the same period of 2025. The company also disclosed cumulative losses of IDR 1.28 trillion and negative working capital of IDR 349 billion as of 30 June 2026, and noted the permanent closure of the CGV Studio Pekanbaru location.

topics.topic: Coeli Asset Management enters Indonesian market by buying shares of GoTo Gojek Tokopedia and Bank Central Asia
topics.known_state: Coeli Asset Management entered the Indonesian market for the first time, purchasing shares of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) amid a roughly 30% year‑to‑date decline in the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG), raising its Indonesia allocation to nearly 6% of its portfolio.

topics.topic: Astra International interim dividend announcement
topics.known_state: Astra International (ASII) declared an interim dividend of Rp98 per share, representing a total payout of Rp3.89 trillion (31.09% of mid‑2026 net profit of Rp12.53 trillion). The dividend was approved by the board on 10 Sep 2026 and by the commissioners on 30 Sep 2026, with a dividend yield of 2.12% based on the closing price of Rp4,630 on 2 Oct 2026. The payout schedule includes cum and ex dates in October and payment on 30 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: PT Jababeka acquisition of 51% stake in PT Kawasan Industri Seafer
topics.known_state: PT Jababeka Tbk (KIJA) completed the acquisition of a 51% stake in PT Kawasan Industri Seafer (KIS) on 1 Oct 2026 through its business entity PT Indocargomas Persada, purchasing 340,863,090 shares for Rp340,863 billion, representing 51% of KIS’s total issued and paid‑up capital. After the transaction, PT Indocargomas Persada became the controlling shareholder with 51%, while PT Seafer Lumina Capital retained 49%.

topics.topic: PT Apexindo Pratama Duta private placement to convert US$4.108 bn debt into new shares
topics.known_state: PT Apexindo Pratama Duta (APEX) will issue 218,090,317 new B‑series common shares at a nominal and issue price of Rp325 per share, representing 5.79% of its capital, to its foreign syndicated lenders as full payment of principal debt amounting to US$4.108 bn (approximately Rp70.879 bn). Shareholder approval is sought at an extraordinary general meeting on 7 Oct 2026, and the new shares must be issued no later than 31 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: MUFG Bank reduces stake in PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk
topics.known_state: MUFG Bank sold 55,938,400 ordinary shares of PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk (ADMF) on 29 Sep 2026 at Rp7,800 each, resulting in an estimated transaction value of about Rp436.32 billion. The sale reduced MUFG Bank’s holding from 233,440,159 shares (18.89% voting rights) to 177,501,759 shares (14.36% voting rights), but the bank affirmed it remains the controlling shareholder.

topics.topic: AALI announces up to Rp400 billion share buyback program
topics.known_state: AALI announced a share buyback program of up to Rp400 billion.

topics.topic: ERAA Erablue network expansion and revenue growth
topics.known_state: ERAA expanded its Erablue network, achieving 88% year‑on‑year revenue growth and a 14.90% cumulative Same‑Store Sales Growth.

topics.topic: Bank Indonesia extends QRIS 0% Merchant Discount Rate to all merchants for transactions up to Rp100,000
topics.known_state: Bank Indonesia decided to extend the QRIS 0% Merchant Discount Rate to all merchants for transactions up to Rp100,000, effective 1 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia gold account base growth
topics.known_state: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BBRI) reported that its gold account base reached 3.05 million active accounts by September 2026, up 1,004% from about 276,000 a year earlier, following the launch of the Open Bundling Emas feature in the BRImo super‑app. Total gold product sales volume rose to Rp5.13 trillion (up 217.42% YoY) and transaction frequency reached 9.01 million (up 658.97% YoY).

topics.topic: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia profit report for period ending Aug 2026
topics.known_state: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) posted a profit of Rp5.30 trillion for the period ending August 2026, a 10.07% year‑on‑year increase. Non‑performing financing remained at 1.8%, and fee‑based income rose 36.27% to Rp5.6 trillion, lifting the fee‑based ratio to 23.07%. Funding grew 17.71% YoY to Rp389 trillion, CASA reached Rp246 trillion, cost of fund fell 37 bps to 2.30%, and financing grew 16.21% YoY to Rp344 trillion.

topics.topic: PT Samudera Indonesia H1 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: PT Samudera Indonesia (SMDR) posted a net profit of US$32.52 million (approximately Rp574.32 billion) for the first half of 2026, with revenue of US$421.76 million (around Rp7.4 trillion) and gross profit of US$74.81 million, up from US$72.58 million in the same period of 2025.

topics.topic: PT Toba Surimi Industries FY2025 dividend, 2026 targets and H1 2026 results
topics.known_state: PT Toba Surimi Industries (CRAB) set a cash dividend for fiscal year 2025 at Rp2 per share, totaling Rp3.9 billion (about 17.08% of its 2025 net profit of Rp22.83 billion). The company disclosed 2026 financial targets of Rp631.10 billion net sales, Rp76.62 billion gross profit, Rp31.61 billion operating profit and Rp31.51 billion profit before tax. For the first half of 2026, CRAB reported net sales of Rp322.13 billion (up 8.0% YoY) and net profit of Rp3.94 billion, with EPS of Rp2.02, liabilities rising 168.03% to Rp125.22 billion and assets increasing 28.87% to Rp367.78 billion.

topics.topic: Edwin Soeryadjaya raises stake in PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk to 35.97%
topics.known_state: Edwin Soeryadjaya, the controlling shareholder of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG), increased his ownership to 35.9724% as of 2 Oct 2026 by purchasing 938,900 shares at Rp1,790‑Rp1,766 per share for a total of Rp1.67 billion.

topics.topic: PT Telkom Indonesia share buyback for shareholders rejecting second‑phase fiber‑optics spin‑off
topics.known_state: PT Telkom Indonesia (TLKM) is offering a share buyback at Rp2,290 per share as an exit option for shareholders who voted against the second‑phase spin‑off of its wholesale fiber connectivity business. The buyback is available to investors who held TLKM shares on 7 Sep 2026, attended the shareholders meeting, and formally rejected the spin‑off, with applications due by 5 Oct 2026 17:00 WIB and payment to be made within seven business days after the spin‑off completes.

topics.topic: Visionary Capital Global acquires 56.84% controlling stake in PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara
topics.known_state: Visionary Capital Global Pte. Ltd. acquired a controlling 56.84% stake in PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara Tbk (TGUK) by purchasing 2,030,032,377 ordinary shares at Rp20 per share, for a total transaction value of Rp40.60 billion, under a Conditional Share Purchase Agreement executed on 2 Oct 2026, becoming the new controlling shareholder.

topics.topic: PT Bumi Resources semester‑I 2026 net profit increase and long‑term debt rise
topics.known_state: PT Bumi Resources (BUMI) posted a near‑three‑fold increase in semester‑I 2026 net profit to US$59 million, while its long‑term debt rose to US$382.84 million. Total liabilities reached US$1.64 billion (+23.41% YoY) and assets grew to US$4.59 billion (+8.88% YoY). Coal segment revenue surged 19% QoQ (52% YoY) and gold segment revenue fell 56% QoQ (48% YoY).

topics.topic: GoTo Gojek Tokopedia 2026 results and Rp3.5 trillion share buyback with reverse split
topics.known_state: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) posted net profit of Rp171 billion in Q1 2026 and Rp252 billion in Q2 2026, with Q2 revenue of Rp5.7 trillion (up 31% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of Rp1 trillion. The company announced a share buyback budget of up to Rp3.5 trillion, plans to cancel 32 billion treasury shares, and will implement a reverse split. Shareholder approval is sought on 14 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: PT Bank Mandiri interim dividend for 2026
topics.known_state: PT Bank Mandiri (BMRI) announced an interim dividend for 2026 of Rp66 per share, amounting to Rp6.16 trillion, bringing total 2026 dividend payments to about Rp50.63 trillion.

topics.topic: PT Bank Mandiri first eight months 2026 net profit
topics.known_state: PT Bank Mandiri (BMRI) reported net profit for the first eight months of 2026 rose 22.3% year‑on‑year, alongside credit and third‑party fund growth of about 17.6% year‑on‑year.

topics.topic: Pertamina Geothermal Energy H1 2026 revenue, profit and geothermal generation
topics.known_state: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO) reported first‑half 2026 results with revenue of US$235,027 million (up 14.7% YoY) and net profit of US$79,605 million (up 15.48% YoY). Total geothermal generation reached 3,222 GWh, a 12.7% YoY increase. Capacity factor was reported as 101.14% in one disclosure and 90.62% in another; availability was reported as 99.22% in one disclosure and 99.51% in another, with downtime noted as 0.15%. The company targets 5,255 GWh for the full year and reported avoidance of 2.33 million tons of CO₂e emissions. Equity stood at US$2,006 billion and liabilities decreased 2.80% to US$961,184 million.

topics.topic: Pertamina Geothermal Energy Lumut Balai Units 3 and 4 approval and 230 MW co‑generation project PPA
topics.known_state: PGEO's Lumut Balai Unit 3 and Unit 4 projects were approved in Q1 2026, with potential foreign‑loan financing of US$158.86 million for Unit 3 and US$148.97 million for Unit 4 after being listed in the 2026 Green Book; a 230 MW co‑generation project aims to sign a power purchase agreement in Q4 2026.

topics.topic: PT DCI Indonesia expands data‑center capacity to over 2 GW
topics.known_state: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk (DCII) announced expansion of its data‑center platform to over 2 GW, currently operating 132 MW across nine data centers with colocation services contributing about 94% of revenue; its H1 campus in Cibitung provides 75 MW (57% of total) and can grow to 220 MW, while the JK7 project will add roughly 120 MW by 2027 and the H5 park targets about 1 GW, supported by 100% power availability since 2013 and Tier IV certifications.

topics.topic: PT Mayora Indah H1 2026 net profit and gross margin
topics.known_state: Mayora posted a 46.5% year‑on‑year increase in net profit to Rp 1.71 trillion and a gross margin of 25.7% in the first half of 2026, with revenue of Rp 17.92 trillion, a 5% YoY decline in cost of goods sold to Rp 13.30 trillion, a currency gain of 198.8% YoY (Rp 309.78 billion), and export sales representing about 40% of total revenue.

topics.topic: PT Mayora Indah partnership with RANS Entertainment
topics.known_state: Mayora announced a partnership with RANS Entertainment to strengthen its brand.

topics.topic: Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper H1 2026 sales and net profit
topics.known_state: Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk (INKP) posted first‑half 2026 sales of US$1.70 billion and net profit of US$372 million, an 8.7% sales increase and more than double profit.

topics.topic: Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia H1 2026 sales and net profit
topics.known_state: Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia Tbk (TKIM) recorded first‑half 2026 sales of US$528.6 million and net profit of US$262.5 million, a 7.8% sales rise.

topics.topic: Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper new Karawang plant adds 3.9 million tons industrial paper and packaging capacity
topics.known_state: The new Karawang plant adds about 3.9 million tons of industrial paper and packaging capacity for INKP, which could cushion margin pressure if pulp prices weaken.

topics.topic: PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera acquisition of 75% of Bangkok Tellink Co Ltd
topics.known_state: PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera (NAYZ) announced a plan and signed a Conditional Share Transfer Agreement to acquire 5,692,500 shares, representing 75% of Bangkok Tellink Co Ltd's paid‑up capital, for a maximum consideration of US$125 million, with 20% payable in cash after closing and 80% as a non‑cash capital contribution from Saiko Consultancy Pte. Ltd; the transaction awaits shareholder approval and other conditions.

topics.topic: VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas 15 billion‑share right issue to raise up to Rp 3 trillion
topics.known_state: VKTR will offer 15 billion new shares at an execution price of Rp 200 per share, with OJK confirming the issuance on 29 September 2026, potentially generating up to Rp 3 trillion; approximately 66.86% of net proceeds will be used for a capital injection into PT Sarana Ekomobilitas Indonesia (SEI) to support vehicle purchases in 2026‑2027, the remainder for working capital; major shareholder PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk (BNBR) will transfer its entitlement to PT Bakrie Capital Indonesia (BCI), which plans to subscribe for roughly 3.66 billion shares (≈Rp 732 billion), and BCI together with PT Biofuel Indo Sumatra (BIS) will act as standby buyers for up to 11.34 billion shares (≈Rp 2.27 trillion).

topics.topic: Asuransi Harta Aman Pratama OJK approval for up to 3.5 billion share rights issue at Rp 50
topics.known_state: AHAP obtained OJK approval to launch a rights issue of up to 3.5 billion new shares at a subscription price of Rp 50 per share, potentially raising Rp 175 billion to increase equity from Rp 216 billion (as of 30 Sept 2025) to meet the minimum equity requirement of Rp 250 billion; the rights issue is set at a 7:5 ratio, with a maximum dilution of 41.67% for non‑exercising shareholders, and the controlling shareholder PT Asuransi Central Asia (ACA) may fully subscribe to satisfy the equity target by 31 Dec 2026; trading will be cum on 8 Oct 2026 and ex on 9 Oct 2026, with subscription, payment, allocation and refund processes scheduled between 14 Oct and 26 Oct 2026, and the new shares to be listed on the BEI.

topics.topic: OJK fines 136 capital‑market participants total Rp 112.79 billion and revises market rules
topics.known_state: OJK imposed administrative fines totaling Rp 112.79 billion on 136 capital‑market participants for cases examined from January to September 2026, including two license revocations, one registration certificate cancellation, six license freezes, 18 written warnings and five written orders; OJK and the Self‑Regulatory Organization eliminated the minimum share‑price floor from Rp 50 to as low as Rp 1 per share effective 28 September 2026, and OJK and Bursa Efek Indonesia began implementing financing for short‑selling transactions, subject to infrastructure readiness and risk mitigation.

topics.topic: Chinese pulp price at US$585 per ton in 2026
topics.known_state: Chinese pulp prices hover around US$585 per ton in 2026.

topics.topic: New pulp capacity expected to come online: 2.8 million tons in China, 1.4 million tons from OKI II, 3.5 million tons in Brazil
topics.known_state: New pulp capacity of roughly 2.8 million tons in China, 1.4 million tons from OKI II, and 3.5 million tons in Brazil is expected to come online, contributing to the sector outlook for 2027 and 2028.

topics.topic: GoTo Gojek Tokopedia loan book expands 58% YoY
topics.known_state: GOTO’s loan book expanded 58% year‑on‑year.

topics.topic: NAYZ acquisition of 75% stake in Bangkok Tellink
topics.known_state: NAYZ announced acquisition of a 75% stake in Bangkok Tellink via transfer of 5,692,500 shares valued at US$125 million (≈Rp2.2 trillion), valuing Bangkok Tellink at US$166.7 million; payment will be 20% cash and 80% rights issue under the HMETD scheme, subject to reference‑value adjustment, independent valuation, shareholder approval and POJK No. 42/2020 and No. 17/2020; Saiko Consultancy, holder of 29.41% of NAYZ, becomes new controlling shareholder and seller; NAYZ plans to divest its baby‑food subsidiaries PT Mitra Kerja Nayz and PT Nutrisi Juara Asia; a mandatory tender offer priced at Rp75 per share began on 5 Oct 2026; NAYZ’s share price rose from the “gocap” level of Rp50 to as high as Rp80 after the announcement; NAYZ’s equity is roughly Rp63 billion with cash of Rp6 billion and market capitalisation below Rp200 billion.

topics.topic: Indonesia capital market investor base and IPO fundraising Q3 2026
topics.known_state: Investor base reached 32.17 million in September 2026 (57.96% YTD increase); only seven companies raised Rp2.16 trillion in IPOs, far below last year’s 15 IPOs and Rp11.35 trillion; total fundraising Jan‑Sep 2026 amounted to Rp186.03 trillion (74.4% of Rp250 trillion target), dominated by debt instruments (PUB EBUS Rp125.53 trillion) and rights issues (Rp47.91 trillion).

topics.topic: PT Mayora Indah H1 2026 sales performance
topics.known_state: Mayora reported 0.7% YoY domestic sales growth in H1 2026, overcame Q1 distribution disruption, and achieved >15% sales surge in July 2026, exceeding internal >10% target; raw‑material prices fell (coffee ‑21%, cocoa ‑37%, sugar ‑16%, coconut oil ‑20%); company maintains FY revenue growth guidance of 5‑8% and gross‑margin target of 24‑25%.

topics.topic: PT Bukit Asam working‑capital loan facility
topics.known_state: PT Bukit Asam secured up to Rp6 trillion in working‑capital loans, comprising Rp2 trillion from PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia and Rp4 trillion from PT Bank Mandiri.

topics.topic: PT Kian Santang Muliatama oil‑and‑gas project working‑capital loan
topics.known_state: PT Kian Santang Muliatama obtained a Rp39.5 billion loan from PT Bank Syariah Indonesia for oil‑and‑gas project working capital, 12‑month term.

topics.topic: PT Sinar Eka Selaras loan facility expansion
topics.known_state: PT Sinar Eka Selaras raised its Time Loan facility to Rp600 billion and expanded its Multi Credit Facility to Rp540 billion, adding foreign‑currency limits.

topics.topic: PT Victoria Care loan package
topics.known_state: PT Victoria Care secured a Rp270.65 billion loan package from PT Bank Negara Indonesia.

topics.topic: PT Murni Sadar investment‑credit facility restructuring
topics.known_state: PT Murni Sadar shifted Rp60 billion to a new tranche and reduced the original tranche to Rp190 billion.

topics.topic: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya interim dividend FY 2026
topics.known_state: AMRT will distribute an interim dividend of Rp595.83 billion (Rp14.5 per share), representing about 29.4% of net profit (Rp2.025 trillion), with dividend schedule: regular‑market cum‑date 13 Oct, cash cum‑date 15 Oct, ex‑dates 14 Oct (regular) and 16 Oct (cash), record date 15 Oct, payment 27 Oct 2026; unrestricted retained earnings Rp15.494 trillion, total equity Rp19.158 trillion as of 30 June 2026; stock declined >36% YTD.

topics.topic: PT Astra Otoparts interim dividend FY 2026
topics.known_state: AUTO will distribute an interim dividend of Rp349.52 billion (Rp72.52 per share) (also reported as Rp349.53 billion), representing 30.4% of mid‑2026 net profit Rp1.15 trillion, yield ~2.1% based on closing price near Rp3,450; payout payable 26 Oct 2026, regular‑market cum‑date 13 Oct, cash cum‑date 15 Oct, ex‑dates 14 Oct (regular) and 16 Oct (cash), record date 15 Oct, payment 26 Oct 2026; retained earnings Rp11.98 trillion, total equity Rp17.19 trillion.

topics.topic: PT Remitra Global International private placement raising Rp200 billion
topics.known_state: MKNT completed a private placement issuing 1,024 trillion new shares at Rp1 per share, raising paid‑up capital to about Rp1.13 trillion; new shares taken up by seven parties, with PT Headwell Bintang Energi Hijau acquiring 668 billion shares, PT Mantra Capital Persadan acquiring 156.49 billion shares, five individual investors contributing Rp200 billion cash; from the Rp200 billion, Rp160,000,003,192 will be transferred to PT Citra Baru Steel, Rp30 billion to PT Radja Udang Malingping, and the remaining Rp9,999,996,808 to MKNT; PT Mantra Capital also contributed Rp1,564,900,000 to settle purchase price of RUM shares owed to PT Mazon Bumi Mining.

topics.topic: Indonesia Composite Index September 2026 decline
topics.known_state: IHSG fell about 6.96% to approximately 6,071 points in September 2026 (close 6,071.14/6,071.13), foreign investors net sold Rp10.24 trillion, reversing August’s net buy of Rp1.19 trillion; average bid‑ask spread around 1.2%; OJK executive attributed weakness to global volatility, geopolitical tensions and higher global interest rates; Indonesia Composite Bond Index rose 0.23% to 439.05; limited net outflow of Rp0.34 trillion from government securities.

topics.topic: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources H1 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: SMAR posted H1 2026 revenue of Rp43.73 trillion and net profit of Rp2.34 trillion; shares surged 88.68% YTD, trading at Rp9,000.

topics.topic: Commissioner Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara purchase of PT Dharma Polimetal shares
topics.known_state: On 30 September 2026, the commissioner bought 5,000,000 shares of PT Dharma Polimetal at Rp800 per share, raising his holding to 84.5 million shares (1.80% of issuer), up from 79.5 million shares (1.69%).

topics.topic: Resignation of PT Bank Neo Commerce President Director Eri Budiono
topics.known_state: Eri Budiono submitted resignation on 2 October 2026, to be submitted for shareholder approval at upcoming RUPS; stated not to constitute material impact on operations or financial condition.

topics.topic: Removal of minimum share price floor to Rp1
topics.known_state: OJK removed the Rp50 minimum price floor for stocks, effective 28 September 2026, lowering the minimum share price to Rp1, enabling functional price discovery, higher liquidity, and stabilising prices for shares previously stuck at the floor.

topics.topic: Bank Indonesia reference rate increase to 5.75%
topics.known_state: Bank Indonesia reference rate increased to 5.75%, up 100 basis points since start of 2026; weighted‑average deposit rates rose 7 basis points month‑on‑month, loan rates rose 3 basis points month‑on‑month.

topics.topic: PT Krom Bank Indonesia Aug 2026 credit growth and profit
topics.known_state: In August 2026, PT Krom Bank Indonesia’s credit grew 50.4% YoY to Rp11.59 trillion, net profit rose 41.4% YoY to Rp144.98 billion, net interest income increased 73.2% YoY to Rp1.87 trillion, and asset‑impairment provision grew to Rp1.37 trillion.

topics.topic: PT Allo Bank Indonesia Aug 2026 credit growth and profit
topics.known_state: In August 2026, PT Allo Bank Indonesia’s credit grew 32.02% YoY to Rp9.46 trillion, net interest income rose 14.5% YoY to Rp1.06 trillion, net profit fell 4.05% YoY to Rp298.85 billion, and impairment losses rose 70.9% YoY to Rp394.28 billion.

topics.topic: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia planned Q1 2027 rights issue
topics.known_state: BRIS intends to issue up to 6.8 billion new Series B shares in Q1 2027, aiming to raise free‑float to ~21% and equity to Rp64.41 trillion (from Rp51.07 trillion 2026); major shareholders BMRI, BBNI and BBRI would be diluted from 51.5%, 23.2% and 15.4% to about 44.9%, 20.3% and 13.4% respectively; CAR would rise to 23.31% (up 293 bps).

topics.topic: Indonesia syndicated loan market growth to Oct 2026
topics.known_state: Syndicated loan market grew 36.9% YoY to US$25.51 billion (≈Rp456 trillion) across 49 MLA deals up to 1 October 2026; BNI led with US$4.23 billion in 20 projects, followed by BMRI US$3.67 billion (19 projects), BRI US$2.40 billion (14 projects), BCA US$1.54 billion (13 projects), UOB US$1.31 billion (9 projects), OCBC US$948.6 million (7 projects); sector breakdown: energy US$5.36 billion, mining US$4.76 billion, infrastructure & transport US$4.43 billion, data centres US$1.75 billion.

topics.topic: OJK inspection of PT Asuransi Bintang
topics.known_state: OJK is conducting a regulatory inspection of PT Asuransi Bintang following reports of fund and investment embezzlement; ASBI reported revised ratios as of 31 July 2026: RBC 140.77%, IAR 178.76%, Liquidity 101.78%, SBN coverage 3.28%; pro‑forma New RBC 209% (Available Capital Rp371.8 billion vs Required Capital Rp177.9 billion); CFO dismissed, independent task force formed, alleged money‑laundering case reported to police and BEI.

topics.topic: Visionary Capital Global acquisition of PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara
topics.known_state: VCG purchased 2.03 billion shares of PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara at Rp20 each, acquiring 56.84% stake and becoming controlling shareholder; TGUK shares closed up 9.48% at Rp127, reflecting 42.7% gain over five days and 89.55% rise in a month; VCG must launch mandatory tender offer, appointing PT Artha Global Trikanaka Investama to execute.

topics.topic: Protelindo sustainable bond issuance 2026
topics.known_state: Protelindo launched second tranche of Sustainable Bond V 2026, raising Rp741.05 billion (Series A Rp602.86 billion, 7.55% coupon, 3‑year tenor maturing 20 Oct 2029; Series B Rp138.20 billion, 7.65% coupon, 5‑year tenor maturing 20 Oct 2031); proceeds to repay bank loans, support working capital and capex, fund telecom infrastructure; bonds offered at 100% of nominal, AAA(idn) rating from Fitch, guaranteed by five securities firms, slated for listing on IDX on 21 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: PT Astra International interim dividend 30 Oct 2026
topics.known_state: ASII will pay an interim dividend of Rp3.89 trillion (Rp98 per share) on 30 October 2026.

topics.topic: PT United Tractors interim dividend shifted to Nov 2026
topics.known_state: UNTR announced interim dividend of Rp1.47 trillion (Rp430 per share), payment shifted to November 2026.

topics.topic: PT Astra Agro Lestari interim dividend 26 Oct 2026
topics.known_state: AALI will distribute an interim dividend of Rp449.02 billion on 26 October 2026.

topics.topic: PT Astra Graphia additional final cash dividend proposal
topics.known_state: ASGR changed its interim dividend to an additional final cash dividend of at least Rp400.05 billion (Rp297 per share), pending approval at extraordinary shareholders meeting in November 2026.

topics.topic: PT Energi Mega Persada sustainable bond issuance Oct 2026
topics.known_state: ENRG announced Rp500 billion Sustainable Bond I Phase V 2026 issuance (Series A Rp387.34 billion, 9% fixed, 370‑day tenor; Series B Rp112.66 billion, 10% fixed, 3‑year tenor); interest payable quarterly, first payment 22 January 2027; proceeds: ~20.22% retained by ENRG, ~40.44% transferred to PT Energi Maju Abadi, remainder to PT EMP Energi Gandewa and PT EMP Energi Riau; idA+ rating; part of Rp4 trillion public offering program; subscription 15‑19 Oct 2026, electronic distribution 22 Oct, listing 23 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: PT Merdeka Copper Gold sustainable bond offering
topics.known_state: MDKA announced sustainable bond issuance of Rp4.12 trillion (Series A Rp1.81 trillion, 8.25% coupon, 367‑day tenor; Series B Rp2.31 trillion, 10% coupon, 3‑year tenor); proceeds: ~Rp3.48 trillion to refinance bank debt and ~Rp614.9 billion to refinance existing bonds; unsecured, pari‑passu; idA+ rating; public offering 14‑15 Oct 2026, electronic distribution 20 Oct, listing 21 Oct 2026; optional buy‑back after one year.

topics.topic: VKTR director purchase of 15 million shares
topics.known_state: Director and COO Valentinus Bimo Kurniatmoko bought 15 million shares of PT VKTR at Rp720 per share, costing Rp10.8 billion; reported on 30 Sep 2026; stake described as 0.03% or 0.3% of outstanding shares.

topics.topic: RATU semester‑I 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: RATU reported semester‑I 2026 revenue of US$25.6 million, net profit of US$15.5 million, and adjusted EBITDA of US$21.28 million, a 38% YoY increase.

topics.topic: DSSA semester‑I 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: DSSA reported semester‑I 2026 revenue of US$1.77 billion (+34% YoY) and profit attributable to shareholders of US$174.4 million (+79.6% YoY).

topics.topic: BSDE H1 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: BSDE reported first‑half 2026 revenue of Rp4.75 trillion and net profit of Rp603.89 billion, both down from the same period in 2025.

topics.topic: AMRT removal from MSCI Global Standard index
topics.known_state: On 5 Oct 2026, AMRT shares slipped 0.40% to Rp1,260 after the company was removed from the MSCI Global Standard index.

topics.topic: PPRI director Irsyad Hanif share sale
topics.known_state: Director Utama Irsyad Hanif sold 3 million PPRI shares on 1 Oct 2026 at Rp148 per share, reducing his holding to 150.5883 million shares (14.01%); follows earlier September sales of 6.3329 million shares at Rp196‑194.

topics.topic: BYAN investor base increase Sep 2026
topics.known_state: BYAN’s number of shareholders increased from 4,939 to 8,187 in September 2026 (65.76% month‑on‑month), adding 3,248 investors; free‑float shares rose to 7,096,416,630 (21.289% of total), up 709,500 shares; stock closed up 4.26% at Rp12,250 on 5 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: PT Jhonlin Baratama conditional purchase of ~30% BYAN shares
topics.known_state: On 16 Sep 2026, PT Jhonlin Baratama signed a conditional share purchase agreement to acquire about 10 billion BYAN shares (≈30%) from Dato' Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low.

topics.topic: BSBK interim dividend FY 2026
topics.known_state: BSBK will distribute an interim dividend of Rp25.09 billion (Rp1 per share), representing about 63% of 2026 net profit of Rp39.83 billion; yield ~2.5% based on closing price around Rp40 on 5 Oct 2026; board approved 1 Oct 2026; regular‑market cum‑date 13 Oct, ex‑date 14 Oct, cash‑cum‑date 15 Oct, ex‑date 16 Oct, record date 15 Oct, payment scheduled for 20 Oct 2026.

topics.topic: MGLV shareholder loan to NAC and NGC
topics.known_state: MGLV granted a Rp4 trillion shareholder loan to subsidiaries T Nextier Askara Center (NAC) and PT Nextier GenAi Center (NGC), allocating Rp1.5 trillion to NAC and Rp2.5 trillion to NGC; loan signed 2 Oct 2026, 7% annual interest, matures 31 Dec 2028; intended to fund data‑center development in Jababeka, Cikarang and KEK Industropolis KITB Batang.

topics.topic: WIKA bond‑holders meeting on missed sukuk profit‑sharing payments
topics.known_state: WIKA will hold a bond‑holders meeting on 20 Oct 2026 to explain missed profit‑sharing payments for its 2022 Sukuk Mudharabah Berkelanjutan II, covering missed 14th installment of Series A and missed 18th installment of Series B and C, and present proposals for sukuk holders' vote.
